'''GeneSculpt''' was a company that specialized in genetic engineering and [[Nanotechnology/Legends|nanotechnology]]. Their data was stolen by the [[Null-class Advanced Recon Commando|Null Arcs]] in order to gather enough information to stop their accelerated aging.<ref name="o66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref>
